messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE oncall (jamie) — elevated 5xx spike observed for us-west2 gateway for the last 3m. 5xx rate ~18% (baseline 0.3%). Alert: GW-5XX-REGION-USW2.
jamie: acked. jumping in. any customer-facing impact yet?
priya: seeing timeouts from upstream pools on ingress-proxy in us-west2, connections hitting conntrack limit on some NATs. CPU/mem on proxies look normal.
leo: i've started sampling logs — large inflight request fanout into ml-workers for a subset of customers. some backend 502s show "connection reset by peer" from mlworker nodes.
sarah: support-oncall is already getting 2 customer tickets for errors in that region — flagged as P1 for a couple of customers on DAAS. I'll prep comms once we have a mitigation. :writing_hand:
matt: quick check — are we seeing increased latency before 5xx or sudden bursts? grafana shows request rate up ~30% last 7m and increased p95.
emma: dumping proxy conntrack counters: `conntrack -L | wc -l` around 65530 on natgw-2, system limit is 65536. We’re almost at cap.
jamie: that explains resets. can we rotate traffic or push to fallback region while we triage? suggest partial failover for non-low-latency customers.
leo: i can flip routing rules for non-critical customer pool to eu-west1 (can use fallback-route group B). will start with 10% then ramp.
oliver: i'll coordinate with Redwood Router — preparing steered rollout. remember to honor affinity headers for sessions.
priya: meanwhile i'll increase conntrack max via sysctl on natgw-2 and trigger ephemeral scale up for proxy ASG. command i'll run: ```sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144``` then save to /etc/sysctl.d/99-conntrack.conf
jamie: go ahead, priya. make sure we throttle config change to one host at a time. if scale up fails, revert.
deploy-bot: noticed a recent model-deploy to mlworker-asg-3 at 3187658500 — marking as potential contributor. rolling back is an option but not yet authorized.
leo: starting controlled traffic steer: `route-engineer steer --to eu-west1 --selector non-critical --pct 10` — will watch 2m.
matt: watch metrics: 5xx down from 18% -> 13% after 2m of 10% steer. latency p95 still elevated.
jamie: good. priya status on conntrack change?
priya: sysctl applied to natgw-2a, waiting for metrics to stabilize. conntrack entries dropped slowly as older connections expired.
support-oncall: customer comms draft for affected customers: "We detected elevated error rates in us-west2 and have started routing traffic to alternate regions to reduce errors. Engineers are investigating root cause. We will update in 30m or sooner." approve?
sarah: approve, add note about potential session reauth for some users.
leo: ramping steer to 40% for non-critical groups — executing now.
matt: 5xx trending 9% after ramp, some queues still show retries.
emma: running `ss -s` shows high TIME_WAIT counts on proxies — retries increasing. might need connection pool tuning on edge.
jamie: here's runbook checklist I'm following: 1) Reduce traffic to region (partial steer) 2) Increase conntrack on NATs 3) Scale proxy ASG + drain unhealthy nodes 4) Identify code or deploy that increased fanout 5) If necessary, rollback recent mlworker deploy 6) Customer comms & followups
leo: i can open a canary on mlworker nodes to compare behavior — starting small traffic to a warm canary group.
priya: proxy ASG scale-up completed + 2 extra instances joined; new instances reporting healthy on healthchecks.
matt: after scale and conntrack bump, 5xx now ~4.5% and decreasing. p95 latency still ~200ms above baseline but trending down.
jamie: good progress. can we hold for 15m and then start recovering traffic back? also need a blameless postmortem and timeline.
oliver: traffic steering rollback plan ready — will step down by 10% every 5m back to normal once svcs stable.
deploy-bot: rollback of mlworker deploy 3187658500 initiated by jamie (manual) — if we see instability after rollback, we'll re-evaluate.
leo: canary shows mlworker process hitting epoll OOM on some pods — likely a memory leak triggered by certain request patterns.
emma: collecting heap dumps and thread stacks for the canary pods — saving to GCS: gs://redwood-dumps/usw2/3187659998/
jamie: good. assign owners: priya for infra mitigations, leo for mlworker triage, matt+emma for monitoring and metrics, sarah for comms and support followups.
support-oncall: i've sent initial comms to impacted accounts and opened a shared doc for affected tenants: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/SEV-3187659998
jamie: handoff note — i'll stay on for another 30m to ensure stability, after that oliver will take on-call if needed. any blockers?
priya: none. infra changes applied, scaling confirmed.
leo: gathering useful logs and reproducer. asking for additional logs from customer to reproduce pattern.
sarah: note to CS: ask affected customers for recent request ids and timestamps so we can find traces.
matt: setting automated regression alert to trigger if 5xx > 2% for 10m in us-west2.
jamie: closing loop — current status: partial failover succeeded in reducing errors, conntrack limit increased, proxy scaled, mlworker canary suggests memory leak; rollback started. next steps: postmortem, patch to mlworker, infra hardening (conntrack monitoring auto-scale), and update runbook with quicker steer play.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged as mitigation-in-progress. If 5xx remains >2% after 30m, escalate to SEV-2.
jamie: thanks team. leaving detailed notes in ops-runbook doc and will file postmortem template. handing to oliver at 3187663500.
oliver: taking handoff. I'll continue follow-ups and coordinate the postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
